title: Agent Harness Profile 0.2 template manifest (template.json)
description: Manifest of a template bundle. Lists every file of the bundle with its role, the standard it follows and the SHA-256 digest of its exact bytes. Profile: https://orbanplatform.com/agent-harness/0.2. Requirement levels in property descriptions follow the profile: Required, Conditionally Required, Recommended, Opt-In.

$schema.description: Recommended. URI of this JSON Schema. When present it MUST be exactly this schema's $id.

profile_version.description: Required. Profile version (semver) the bundle was written against. MUST be 0.1.0.

id.description: Required. Template identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or digit.

title.description: Required. Short human-readable title of the template.

summary.description: Required. Plain-language summary of the agent's job, at most 500 characters.

locale.description: Required. BCP 47 language tag of the human-readable text in the bundle, for example en or zh-TW.

files.description: Required. Every file of the bundle except template.json itself. Exactly one entry each with role agent, harness, policy and acceptance, and at least one entry with role skill. Paths are unique.

provenance.description: Required. Who or what produced the bundle and whether a human reviewed it.

generated_by.description: Required. The word human, or the name (and version, if known) of the tool that generated the bundle.

reviewed_by_human.description: Required. True if a human reviewed the whole bundle before publication.

created.description: Required. RFC 3339 date-time at which the bundle was created.

role.description: Required. What the file is: agent (agent.json), harness (harness.json), policy (policy.cedar), acceptance (acceptance.json) or skill (skills/<name>/SKILL.md).

path.description: Required. Path relative to the bundle root, using / separators, with no leading /, no empty, . or .. segments.

standard.description: Required. Standard and version the file follows: agentspec@26.3.1 for agent, agent-harness@0.2.0 for harness and acceptance, cedar@4 for policy, agentskills for skill.

sha256.description: Required. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file bytes exactly as stored.
